data.raw_text:
ZALDY CO: REVELATION OF A DEAD MAN

For all intent and purposes, Zaldy Co knew he is a dead man still walking on the street. Marcos Jr. and Martin Romualdez already betrayed him. And they are not working alone. They work with the biggest criminal syndicate in the world known as the Deep State.

Zaldy Co's only recourse is to die with clear conscience and explode the bomb of truth, all in the hope that Marcos and Romualdez will sink with him to the deepest part of hell.

The explosive video of Zaldy Co was not a total surprise. Everybody knew who is the ultimate mastermind of all the 2025 budget scam and flood control scam. His video merely formalized everything as a matter of evidence and testimony to put Marcos and Romualdez as the actual masterminds.

Zaldy Co's revelation is like a well timed torpedo hitting the poorly crewed and barely moving Marcos ship' belly broadside.  It blew a big hole in its bottom. It may float for a while. 

The only problem is that 100-foot high tsunami waves are coming its way in the form of a 3-days rally expecting at least 2 to 3 million rallyists headed by INC, KOJC, UPI, Muslim brothers and many anti-corruption groups. It's calles a "Marcos Resign" tsunami.

Forget the APF. Forget the PNP. Forget the Colonels and Generals. Forget the Catholic Church. The rally this November 16-17 and 18 maybe be more than enough to capsize the Marcos Jr. administration's boat.

The anger of the Filipino people is bursting. All the business and labor sectors are mad too. Even men in uniforms in lower ranks are fed up too. The video testimony of Zaldy Co will just be the icing on the cake. A mere spark on a ticking timebomb about to explode.

Who will defend Marcos Jr. and Martin Romualdez?

The clowns and puppets like Remullas, Claire Castro, Gibo and Brawner won't be enough. Not even Sotto and Lacson can help. They are all there just for money, not for honor. They know Marcos will be gone sooner or later. Standing in the way of millions of angry Filipino is like stopping the rage of Typhoon Tino: Futile and fatal.

With Zaldy Co's revelation, the Marcos Jr. administration won't have time to balckmail and intimidate people to join the raging Nov. 16 to 18 rally. They will be busy defending and destroying Zaldy Co in the next 48 hours. And Zaldy Co is not yet done. More video revelations are coming.

It's exciting and satisfying to see Marcos and Romualdez getting a dose of their own medicine. They've been scamming, fooling and betraying people left and right in the last three years just to enrich themselves. Only to be hit with bullets between their eyes from the gun of the man they trusted with their secrets. Poetic justice. 

Zaldy Co is not done yet. The video he released was just part one. More are coming. I'm buying enough popcorn and drinks watching Zaldy Co reveal their dirtiest secrets.

I'm excited too who among Marcos Jr.'s puppets will jump the ship first. Let the criminals betray their fellow criminals. Once they're done destroying each other, we the Filipino People will take it from there.

There will be no forgiveness nor mercy. Just pure justice and punishment they truly deserve. 

So let Zaldy Co, a dead man, speak for more truth. Let him take his revenge against the biggest Judases the Philippines politics have everknown. Let him destroy Marcos and Romualdez. 

And if he survives death and help kick Marcos and Roumualdez out, we the Filipino people may give him the forgiveness all sinners deserve.

✍️ Jun Abines FB 🇵🇭

MAHALAGANG ABISO SA MGA MOTORISTA🚦

Bunsod ng isasagawang Peaceful Rally ng United People’s Initiative, asahan ang pagbagal ng daloy ng trapiko sa paligid ng EDSA People Power Monument sa November 16-18, 2025 kabilang ang mga sumusunod na kalsada:

• Epifanio Delos Santos Avenue (EDSA)
• Katipunan Avenue
• Ortigas Avenue
• White Plains Avenue
• Temple Drive

Pansamantalang isasara ang kahabaan ng White Plains Avenue sa pagitan ng EDSA at Katipunan Avenue sa November 16, 2025.

Nakaantabay ang mga tauhan ng Traffic and Transport Management Department (TTMD), Department of Public Order and Safety (DPOS), Task Force Disiplina, at Quezon City Police District (QCPD) para matiyak ang kaayusan ng daloy ng trapiko sa nasabing lugar.

Pinapayuhan ang mga motorista na dumaan sa mga alternatibong ruta. Salamat po sa inyong pang-unawa.

LOOK: Climate activists brave the rains in Manila City today, November 15, for a protest commemorating the Global Day of Action for Climate Justice.

Carrying calls for justice and compensation for victims of disasters, an end to ecocide in countries such as Palestine, and accountability from widespread corruption, the progressive organizations led by Kalikasan People's Network for the Environment started their program along Taft Avenue.

Later, the environmental activists marched along Kalaw Avenue towards the United States Embassy to continue their protest.

AP/Altermidya
